resources.string: Browse and organize the photos and videos on your device. The source code is public on GitHub.
Galery reads the media you let it access. Browsing, searching, and favorites work on your device without an account. When you share an item, Galery gives access to the app you choose.

Update checks connect to GitHub, which may receive your IP address. These requests contain no media, filenames, or searches. You can turn automatic checks off in Settings. Galery keeps a downloaded update in its private cache until installation or cleanup.
Android may back up your Galery preferences if you enable system backup.
Use Galery to view and manage media you have permission to access. Review your selection before sharing it or moving it to the bin. Android decides when items in the bin expire.
Updates come from Galery’s public GitHub repository. You choose when to install them. Galery is provided as is. These terms do not limit any rights you have under applicable law.
